01 / My journey

From the visual
to the functional.

I'm Navjot Singh, a web designer and developer based in Birmingham. I work across UI / UX, WordPress, Webflow and custom development, taking digital experiences from layout to launch.

02 / My approach

Think it through.
Build it properly.

I like understanding how a website should feel and how it needs to work. I connect the design decisions with the development, from responsive layouts to the integrations behind them.

03 / My philosophy

Make it clear.
Make it useful.

A website should do more than look good. It should help someone find what they need, understand the offer and take their next step with confidence.
